name: Android 0.22-preview
body:
## New features / 新功能

- **Drag to reorder providers** — long-press a provider row in Settings → Providers to reorder within its section; model pickers follow the custom order.
  **拖动排序 Provider** — 在设置 → Providers 中长按行即可在同类分组内拖动排序，模型选择器同步跟随自定义顺序。
- **Read Aloud routes through your Voice Output models** — provider TTS (MiMo, MiniMax, Doubao, ElevenLabs, Azure…) with automatic fallback to the on-device engine.
  **朗读走语音输出模型** — 支持 Provider TTS（MiMo、MiniMax、豆包、ElevenLabs、Azure 等），失败时自动回退设备本机引擎。
- **Photos CLI accepts a file path directly** — import/save without flag juggling in agent workflows.
  **照片命令行支持直接传文件路径** — Agent 工作流中导入/保存无需额外参数。

## Fixes / 修复

- **Read Aloud no longer goes silent** — the first tap could be dropped while the speech engine was still starting, and devices without a working system TTS failed with no feedback. Speech is now queued until the engine is ready, and if nothing can speak you get a clear notice instead of silence.
  **朗读不再无声** — 修复语音引擎启动期间首次点击被丢弃的问题；设备无可用系统 TTS 时也不再静默失败，现在会明确提示原因。
- **Jump-to-previous-message button reworked** — each tap now walks back exactly one user turn and aligns it below the header (matching iOS), instead of jumping to the top or landing inconsistently.
  **"跳到上一条"按钮重做** — 每次点击精确回退一轮用户消息并顶部对齐（与 iOS 一致），不再一步跳顶或落点漂移。
- **Sending while the "/" menu is open no longer leaves the text in the input box.**
  **打开 "/" 指令菜单时发送消息，输入框不再残留已发送的文字。**
- **Shell failures now explain themselves** — when the sandbox can't start, the error includes the real cause instead of a bare "Shell not running".
  **Shell 失败原因可见** — 沙箱启动失败时，错误信息会带上真实原因，不再只是一句 "Shell not running"。
- **Replies no longer hang on providers that end streams without a done marker.**
  **修复部分 Provider 流式结束缺少标记导致回复卡住的问题。**
- **A corrupt skill import can no longer brick the app at startup** (GH#147), and scheduled tasks no longer crash on a cold start (GH#156).
  **损坏的技能导入不再导致应用启动失败**（GH#147），定时任务冷启动崩溃已修复（GH#156）。
- **Stopping a turn at the context limit no longer leaves the chat stuck in "streaming" state.**
  **上下文限额停止回合后，会话不再卡在"生成中"状态。**

Full changelog: https://github.com/OpenMinis/OpenMinis/compare/0.1-preview...0.22-preview
